notes.title: New Demo Available Now – Featuring Major Movement Overhaul!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to give you a new demo for Lucky Me.

This update includes a major design change based directly on feedback from our amazing testers — thank you! 🙏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549081/3b2e63a853637c875c14ddc5a3a408901d662a7c.gif[/img]

[b]What's New?[/b]
Movement is now grid-based, which means every step you take is more deliberate and clear. This shift brings a huge boost to the game’s strategic depth. This also means that we’re able to make smarter, tighter, and more satisfying puzzles!

All new never-before-seen levels in Base and Stand up modes!

Whether you're new to Lucky Me or you've played an earlier version, we’d love for you to try the new demo and tell us what you think. 

Sign up to [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd-v0aeJfoTYWf-llkOUqVHo-TyAXUg-3KEcoY9Hi3BWDvseg/viewform]join our beta testing group[/url]! 

See you in the near future for more updates! 🏆🔫

notes.title: Sign up for the Lucky Me Closed Beta
notes.content:
Hey Lucky Me Stans! 👋

The #QuebecGamesCelebration is on!
Check out all the games from our neck of the woods on Steam, starting with Lucky Me!

We’ve got some exciting updates for you! While we continue working on refining the game, we’re gearing up for a closed beta and want YOU to be part of it. This is your chance to play with new mechanics, give us feedback, and help us gather insights

💡What’s New?💡
We’re working on a new rap-inspired mode 🚗🔊💥!

❓ How to Join the Closed Beta:❓
We’re looking for dedicated players to try out the new features, record their gameplay, and share feedback. If you're interested in trying out our new features and sharing feedback, sign up using the form below!

🔗 [url=https://forms.gle/faTc5EducGtGXQsU8]SIGN UP FOR THE BETA[/url]

We can’t wait to hear your thoughts! Sign up, get access to our closed beta, and help us refine these features before the official release.

See you in the near future for more updates! 🏆🔫

notes.title: Hold onto your thinking caps!
notes.content:
The [url=https://www.cerebralpuzzleshowcase.com/]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/url] is like the Olympics for puzzle games. Whether you're a puzzle master or just like to pretend you are, this is your opportunity to discover your next favorite game! We're beyond excited to join this event among some truly mind-boggling games, including a few of our personal favorites!

Lucky Me will be rubbing elbows with the crème de la crème of puzzle games. Dive into our one-of-a-kind puzzle shooter game right now by testing our demo. 

Our team has been working extra hard to bring Lucky Me to life, and snagging a spot in the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase is a HUGE deal for us. You can show us some love by adding Lucky Me to your Steam Wishlist and following us on Steam and social media. Check us out on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@artifact5games]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/artifact_5]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://x.com/Artifact_5]Twitter [/url]for all the latest updates!

The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase will be live on Steam from May 23rd to May 30th, with livestreams from the 23rd to the 26th. So get ready to puzzle your brains out!

notes.title: Lucky Me: official selection of Gradient Convergence
notes.content:
Lucky Me has been selected to be part of the Game Devs of Color Expo’s Gradient Convergence event.

If you don’t know, Gradient Convergence is a collection of games specially curated by Game Devs of Color Expo. It celebrates excellent games by inspiring creators.

Don’t miss the chance to play Lucky Me’s demo and leave us a Steam wishlist.

If you want to know more about the game and our team, tune in this Saturday, September 17, 2022, at 5:25 pm EDT for a dev interview with our creative director, Mo !

notes.title: NEW UPDATE - Death Cam, Skip that Dab and new environment
notes.content:
[b]New feature: helpful hints with the Death Cam[/b]
We’ve added this new hint feature that shows you know which character killed you whenever you fail a puzzle:a new cinematic camera that swoops in and frames your lifeless body and whoever shot you! Learn from it and try again! Check it out below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549081/2f6e0f722e5ea85f255cd48e2f91481ec1ed07b9.gif[/img]

[b]Skip that dab[/b]
You told us, we heard you. You can now skip the dab animation between levels using the right trigger button or left-mouse button and jump to the next level.

Play it now!

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] New surrounding environments and floors added to all levels
[*] Death camera
[*] Skip dab animation between levels
[*] Bolt migration, code is more robust and resilient
[*] Improved config and save/load
[*] Audio pooling
[*] Menu improvements
[*] Breakable walls' debris disappears
[/list]

[b]Lucky Me localization[/b]
Artifact 5 is based in Montréal – home to poutine and the underground city – which means that our team is composed of both English and French speakers. The game is initially available in these two languages, and more will come as we pursue development. Let us know which languages you would like to see in the game.

notes.content:
